content: MK lists further doubtful attributions: an Arabic al-Tawrāt (21 chapters of the Torah), probably wrongly linked to Ibn Turka by a cataloguer because it follows his Munāẓarāt-i Khams in the MS; an R. [fī] l-Wujūd in MS Malik 4196 (copied 1017/1608) following his R. Nuqṭa, which MK can only conjecture to be a copy of the Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid or the R. fī Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda; and two otherwise unknown works (Muhayyij al-Ashwāq, Maʿjūn-i Ilāhī) credited to him by Aḥmad Munzavī.
refers_to_primary: al-Tawrāt; R. [fī] l-Wujūd; Muhayyij al-Ashwāq; Maʿjūn-i Ilāhī
